_meta.title: Technology domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/technology.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing technology.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/technology.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME SIGNATURE AS ENERGY/FINANCE (near-feedforward, many single points of failure), but with THREE differences from Finance. (1) NOT baseline-fractured: Technology is a single connected component at baseline (baseComponents 1), unlike Finance which was pre-split into 2. (2) NOT strictly zero-feedback: Technology has ONE reciprocal pair at baseline (HIPP<->dlPFC), so recurrentFraction is 0.031, not exactly 0 as in Finance. (3) MORE brittle: 12 articulation nodes (single points of failure) versus Finance's 9, and a higher lateral fraction (0.457 vs 0.314). The graph still carries directed control rings (the business-layer ring dlPFC->M1->FPN->CeA->DMN->HIPP->dlPFC via CONTROLS + HIPP->dlPFC DEPENDS_ON), but for only one edge pair does the reverse edge exist.

recurrenceAudit.note: Near-feedforward: exactly ONE reciprocal pair (HIPP->dlPFC DEPENDS_ON and dlPFC->HIPP excit both exist), giving reciprocalEdges 2 / recurrentFraction 0.031 — below the 0.2 mesh benchmark but not the exact 0 Finance showed. The graph carries directed cycles (business-layer control ring dlPFC->M1->FPN->CeA->DMN->HIPP->dlPFC) but almost no true reverse-edge reciprocity. verdict from the module = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.457) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is nearly absent.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE connected component at baseline (34 edge-nodes reachable as a single body). Unlike Finance (baseComponents 2, a pre-split {M1,SMA} dyad), Technology has NO baseline fracture — {SMA,M1} are connected here via SMA->M1 with M1 wired into the main body (M1->THAL, dlPFC->M1, M1->FPN, FORN->M1).

mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: sole attachment of leaf SMA (SMA->M1 is SMA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of TWO islands: the auditory relay {A1, MGN} (THAL->A1; MGN->A1 internal) and the visual cluster {V1, LGN, FEF} (THAL->V1; LGN->V1 and FEF->V1 internal). Removing THAL raises component count to 3. NOTE: leaf S1 does NOT hang off THAL alone here — S1 is also held by CBLM->S1 and S1->CeA.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.PVN: sole attachment of leaf HYPO (PVN->HYPO is HYPO's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of TWO islands: leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG) and the reward cluster {NAcc, OFC, VP, VTA}, whose only route to the main body is OFC->vmPFC. Removing vmPFC raises component count to 3.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1) and leaf FEF (FEF->V1). Removing V1 raises component count to 3.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaves NTS (NTS->AI) and PI (PI->AI). Removing AI raises component count to 3.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of leaf VTA (VTA->NAcc) and leaf VP (NAcc->VP). Removing NAcc raises component count to 3.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: sole bridge of the reward cluster {NAcc, VP, VTA} to vmPFC — NAcc->OFC is that cluster's only link toward the main body.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, 'Data Centers -> IoT & Sensors somatosensory relay'). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback outnumbers feedforward and is functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing', THAL = M4 routing hub.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain (DevOps error signal -> Software Engineering).
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit, 'Software Engineering -> DevOps'). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit, 'value -> context decision'). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit, 'reward -> value coding'). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the interoceptive loop between anterior and posterior insula; the salience/integration stage feeds back to primary interoception. Reciprocal of the existing PI->AI edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge PI->AI (excit, 'body-state integration'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience', PI = M10 'primary interoception'; anterior and posterior/mid insula are reciprocally interconnected within the interoceptive cortex.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} reaches the main body only via AI->dACC. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC. DUAL-PURPOSE: this same edge reattaches the {NAcc, OFC, VP, VTA} reward cluster when vmPFC is removed (OFC then connects to AI, which stays on the main body via dACC), so it also de-articulates vmPFC's reward island.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, OFC = M6 valuation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: SMA reaches the graph only via SMA->M1, so removing M1 isolates it. A corticostriatal edge gives SMA a second anchor into the main body (STRI is a main-body hub); removing M1 then leaves SMA attached via STRI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). STRI already a hub in-graph (THAL->STRI, STRI->CBLM, PRECUNEUS->STRI, STRI->NEOCER, STRI->GP).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} — its only link to the main body is THAL->A1. A cortical anchor off the THAL hub (auditory cortex -> insula) reconnects it when THAL is removed.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience). canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the visual cluster {V1, LGN, FEF} — its only link to the main body is THAL->V1. A ventral-visual-stream edge (V1 -> fusiform) gives V1 a second, non-THAL cortical target; removing THAL then leaves {V1, LGN, FEF} attached via FG. Together with A1->AI this fully de-articulates THAL.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing', FG = 'fusiform gyrus — face/object recognition'. V1 feeds the ventral visual stream (V1 -> V2/V4 -> fusiform) that performs object/face recognition — canonical occipitotemporal projection. FG is already an in-graph node (dlPFC->FG, FG->ECN).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as class='composite'; the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HYPO reaches the graph only via PVN->HYPO, so removing PVN isolates it. Hippocampal HPA-axis feedback onto the hypothalamus gives HYPO a second anchor; removing PVN then leaves HYPO attached via HIPP.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes HIPP = M3 'HPA feedback + memory index', HYPO = M3 'homeostatic set-point'. The hippocampus exerts negative feedback on the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis (canonical HPA glucocorticoid negative-feedback pathway). HIPP is a main-body hub.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway. (The reward-island half of vmPFC's articulation is handled by the AI->OFC edge above.)
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output', PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway. CeA is a main-body hub.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The reward cluster {NAcc, VP, VTA} reaches the main body only via NAcc->OFC->vmPFC, so removing OFC isolates it. A ventral-striatum -> vmPFC edge gives the cluster a second, OFC-independent bridge; removing OFC then leaves {NAcc, VP, VTA} attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Ventral / medial PFC and the nucleus accumbens are densely interconnected in the mesocorticolimbic system (canonical NAcc<->vmPFC connectivity). canonical-nodes NAcc = M11 reward drive, vmPFC = M1 brake.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into TWO leaves on removal: NTS (NTS->AI only) and PI (PI->AI only). This edge reattaches NTS: a visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor. Paired with PI->dACC below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is already an in-graph node (BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, PVN->HYPO, LC->PVN, mPFC->PVN).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, PI (PI->AI only). A posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor; removing AI then leaves PI attached via dACC. Together with NTS->PVN this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: NAcc splits into TWO leaves on removal: VTA (VTA->NAcc only) and VP (NAcc->VP only). This edge reattaches VTA: a mesocortical dopamine projection VTA -> OFC gives VTA a second anchor; removing NAcc then leaves VTA attached via OFC. Paired with VP->VTA below, it de-articulates NAcc.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', OFC = M6 valuation. The VTA sends a canonical mesocortical dopaminergic projection to orbital/prefrontal cortex.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches NAcc's second leaf, VP (NAcc->VP only). A ventral-pallidum -> VTA GABAergic edge gives VP a second anchor via VTA (itself reattached by VTA->OFC above); removing NAcc then leaves VP attached via VTA. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (hedonic output feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 dopamine source. One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.

projectedImpact.method: The 21 proposed edges (8 feedback + 13 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of technology.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. technology.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 8 proposedFeedbackEdges are each the reverse of a pre-existing edge, adding 8 reciprocal pairs to the 1 pre-existing pair (HIPP<->dlPFC) = 9 pairs = 18 reciprocal edges.

baseComponents.note: already a single body at baseline; stays connected.

articulationNodes.reason: Both residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: V1 still cuts off LGN, and A1 still cuts off MGN. This is the same honest floor Energy and Finance bottomed out at (both remained articulate at V1/A1 for the identical LGN/MGN reason). NOTE: V1's OTHER leaf, FEF, is de-fanged only in that {V1,LGN,FEF} is reconnected to the main body via V1->FG; removing V1 itself still isolates FEF and LGN, but LGN is the ungroundable one that keeps V1 in the set regardless.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the technology graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1, so V1 stays a residual articulation point.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1, so A1 stays a residual articulation point.

canonical-nodes marks FPN as class='composite' (the fronto-parietal NETWORK, which already contains dlPFC), not a discrete node. A dlPFC->FPN reciprocal is therefore not a clean monosynaptic node->node projection (it would be a part-to-whole edge). Omitted rather than fabricate a spurious reciprocal.

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: A second anchor for V1's FEF leaf (FEF->dlPFC, frontal-eye-fields <-> dorsolateral-PFC dorsal-attention/frontoparietal connectivity) IS groundable, but it was NOT added because it would not clear V1 from the articulation set while the ungroundable LGN leaf persists. It is recorded here as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding. Likewise a corticothalamic S1<->M1 or FG->V1 reverse were considered but add no de-articulation beyond what V1->FG already provides.
